description: Use when setting up lighting in a Three.js scene: ambient, directional, point, spot, area, or environment lighting. Prevents the common mistake of too many shadow-casting lights, wrong intensity units, or missing environment maps for PBR. Covers all 7 light types, PMREMGenerator, HDR environment maps, physically correct intensity, helpers.
